description: This Java source file defines the ServiceSynchronization class, which manages transaction-based service execution callbacks for commit and rollback events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles registration of services to run after transaction completion, executing them asynchronously or synchronously based on transaction status.

classes.name: ServiceSynchronization
classes.description: Manages registration and execution of services upon transaction commit or rollback, implementing javax.transaction.Synchronization.

classes.name: ServiceExecution
classes.description: Encapsulates details of a service to be executed after transaction completion, including execution logic.

methods.name: registerCommitService
methods.description: Registers a service to run after a transaction commits.

methods.name: registerRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a service to run after a transaction rolls back.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ServiceSynchronization instance associated with the current transaction.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Executes registered services based on transaction completion status.

methods.name: beforeCompletion
methods.description: No implementation; placeholder for pre-completion logic.
